candidates.description: This feature vector represents common suffixes and characters found in Hindi and Chinese typography.
This feature vector activates on character fragments and words in Hindi and Chinese scripts.
This vector activates on various sub-word units and characters primarily found in Devanagari script and Hindi text.
This vector activates on various Hindi and Sanskrit characters and sub-word syllable tokens.
This vector represents sequential numerical digits alongside characters from the Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates on common character n-grams and subword tokens across multiple natural languages, particularly Hindi and Japanese.
This feature vector represents common Hindi morphological suffixes, postpositions, and character fragments associated with grammatical case markers.
This vector represents Devanagari vowel signs and punctuation marks commonly used in Hindi text encoding.
This feature vector represents punctuation marks, specifically commas attached to various Hindi vowel signs and standard characters.
This vector represents common Japanese hiragana characters alongside a stray English trigram.
